collection.title: Polestar 4 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: We currently do not have any wiper blades for the Polestar 4 2024 Onwards model, however, please email us at info@wiperblades.co.uk with a photograph of the wiper arm fitting and the measurements of the blades and we will do our best to find some for you.
